name: Dexi
description: Your Dexi notes library as OpenClaw's long-term memory: auto-recall before each turn, dexi_* tools, /remember and /recall, optional session digest. OAuth sign-in with `openclaw dexi login`.

mcpUrl.label: Dexi MCP URL
mcpUrl.help: Leave blank for Dexi cloud. Only change for a self-hosted or local Dexi backend.

autoRecall.label: Auto-recall
autoRecall.help: Before each turn, search your notes for the incoming message and inject matching titles + snippets as <dexi-context>.

recallMinSimilarity.label: Recall similarity floor
recallMinSimilarity.help: Semantic-similarity threshold (0-1) below which notes are not injected.

sessionDigest.label: Session digest
sessionDigest.help: Write one digest note per session (questions asked + last answer) when the session ends or goes idle. Off by default; never a note per turn.

digestTag.label: Digest tag
digestTag.help: Hashtag placed on digest notes (letters, digits, underscore).

digestIdleMinutes.label: Digest idle minutes
digestIdleMinutes.help: Also flush a session's digest after this many idle minutes.

readOnly.label: Read-only
readOnly.help: Request only the notes:read scope; save/append tools and /remember disappear; no digest.

recallTimeoutMs.label: Recall timeout (ms)
recallTimeoutMs.help: Auto-recall is skipped if Dexi does not answer within this budget.

debug.label: Debug logging
debug.help: Verbose logs for recall, capture, and MCP calls.
